part.name: polygon_cube
part.description: 100 mm reference cube with one recessed (음각) regular-polygon pocket, 30 mm deep, centred on each of the 6 faces. Polygon order: +X triangle(3), -X square(4), +Y pentagon(5), -Y hexagon(6), +Z heptagon(7), -Z octagon(8). The 7-gon/8-gon on the two Z faces are an assumption (user wrote '삼각형, 사각형, 오각형, 육각형 등') - change 'sides' in feature-intent.json if a different polygon is wanted.

reference.origin_definition: Geometric centre of the cube. Global X, Y, Z each normal to one opposing pair of faces. Each polygon pocket is coaxial with its outward face normal and centred on that face.

measurements.name: cube_edge_length
measurements.measurement_instruction: Overall cube edge, one quantity. User stated 10 cm; confirm the exact machined value with calipers across a full face, away from any pocket.

measurements.name: pocket_depth
measurements.measurement_instruction: Perpendicular depth from the outer face plane to the flat pocket floor, one quantity. User stated 3 cm; confirm with a depth gauge. Assumed identical for all 6 pockets - if depths differ, split into M002a..M002f and add one parameter per pocket in feature-intent.json.

measurements.name: tri_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +X face, TRIANGLE pocket. Diameter of the circle through the 3 vertices (vertex-to-centre x2). One quantity. If you can only measure edge length E, circumscribed dia = E / sin(60 deg) = E * 1.1547.

measurements.name: square_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -X face, SQUARE pocket. Diameter of the circle through the 4 vertices (corner-to-corner diagonal). One quantity. From edge length E: circumscribed dia = E * 1.41421.

measurements.name: pentagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +Y face, PENTAGON pocket. Diameter of the circle through the 5 vertices (2x circumradius). One quantity. From edge length E: circumscribed dia = E / sin(36 deg) = E * 1.70130.

measurements.name: hexagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -Y face, HEXAGON pocket. Diameter of the circle through the 6 vertices (across-corners = 2x edge length). One quantity. Across-flats F relates as circumscribed dia = F * 1.15470.

measurements.name: heptagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: +Z (top) face, HEPTAGON (7-gon) pocket - ASSUMED polygon type, confirm. Diameter of the circle through the 7 vertices (2x circumradius). One quantity. From edge length E: circumscribed dia = E / sin(180/7 deg) = E * 2.30476.

measurements.name: octagon_face_circumscribed_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: -Z (bottom) face, OCTAGON (8-gon) pocket - ASSUMED polygon type, confirm. Diameter of the circle through the 8 vertices (across-corners). One quantity. From edge length E: circumscribed dia = E / sin(22.5 deg) = E * 2.61313.

constraints.note: Each polygon pocket is centred on its face (pocket axis passes through the face centre).
Pocket side walls are perpendicular to the face; floor is flat and parallel to the face. No draft, no floor fillet unless a later measurement adds one.
Regular polygons only: all edges equal, all interior angles equal. One vertex points toward local +Z on the side faces and local +Y on the top/bottom faces (clocking = 0).
All six pocket depths equal M002 unless M002 is split per face.
